Title: Model Performance Intelligence Foundation
Summary: Descriptive + recommendation-only performance intelligence computed from DB-M17 attempt history. ModelPerformanceSummary/ModelComparison/PerformanceRecommendation/PerformanceQuery v1 frozen. Verified-success semantics (VERIFIED vs MODEL_RETURNED vs VERIFIED_PREFERRED, verification contradicting a PASS claim never counts), first-attempt success, attempt-chain reconstruction (retry/escalation/provider-failover/human-intervention), cost-per-successful-task includes failed attempts (1+1+4 = 6), ActualCost preferred over labelled EstimatedCost fallback, common-currency reuse (never re-converts historic INR), provider-vs-model-quality failure separation, configurable confidence bands, 7/30/90-day + custom UTC windows, dimension filters/group-by, ranked (never winner-selecting) comparison, non-binding recommendation evidence with PolicyVersion 0.0.0 and zero policy mutation. No database; cache designed-not-implemented. No AI/paid/network calls, zero credentials.

Tests.Note: 34 required scenarios (zero attempts; one success; one failure; 100-attempt mixed; first-attempt success; retry then success; multiple retries; model escalation; provider failover; human intervention; model-quality failure; provider outage; rate limit; build failure; test failure; cost-per-success includes failed attempts; actual-cost preferred; estimated fallback labelled; missing-cost excluded; average/median/P95 duration; task-type/complexity/risk/reasoning-level filters; 7/30-day + custom ranges; low/high confidence; underlying model via two providers; no automatic policy mutation; schema v1 round-trip) + safety scan (no network / credential tokens).

DBM18Overlap.Details: ContextPackage.ps1, TaskClassification.ps1 (DB-M18-owned) untouched. DB-M24 does not read classification outputs; DB-M19 wiring waits for DB-M18.

DBM16Overlap.Details: DB-M16 cost/FX files (AiCostContracts.ps1, AiExchangeRates.ps1, CostCalculator.ps1, config/cost, config/currency) untouched; stored cost fields consumed read-only, no pricing recalculated.

DBM17Overlap.Details: AttemptStore.ps1 and Test-AttemptStore.ps1 untouched; attempt history consumed read-only. No synthetic attempts written into live history.

LaneCOverlap.Details: Lane C WI-07-0.2.4 (state/current-task.json, workbook backups, logs) untouched; config/ai-routing.json hash verified unchanged by the no-policy-mutation test.

NotesForDBM25: Performance summaries expose all component metrics DB-M25 needs (success/failure, retry burden via AverageAttemptsPerSuccessfulTask, cost-per-success, durations) with transparent per-route statistics; verified-success and failure-separation rules are already established. DB-M25's quality-adjusted savings, baseline comparison, and savings calculation remain to be implemented by that milestone.
